name: home.mbuelow.dev/egon-bot
_documentation1: The arguments are being passed to docker run. They can be empty.
_documentation2: You can mount custom stuff via the path /deployments/home_mbuelow_dev_egon_bot/.
_documentation3: 0.0.0.0 exposes the service publicly and 172.17.0.1 internally
_documentation4: GPU: pass /dev/dri/renderD128 (never card1 — DRM master / amdgpu_get_auth failed). group-add is the host GID of that node. No DISPLAY, X socket, or Xorg. shm-size=2g avoids Chromium tab crashes. After host PCI changes: ls -l /dev/dri/by-path/
